capabilities: Sync notes, attachments, and selected settings across devices with client-side AES-256-GCM encryption
Encrypt whole notes or selected text with a password, locally and in the vault file
Sync community plugins, themes, hotkeys, and bookmarks with per-item exclusions
Restore note version history, deleted files, and sync conflicts
Customize file and folder sorting, pin notes, and revisit recently opened files
extras: Freemium: 100 MB free tier; paid yearly plans cost 40–200 CNY with no auto-renewal, paid via WeChat. README notes the encryption has not been independently audited and that account/runtime metadata is outside the encrypted scope. Documentation (manual, FAQ, install guide) lives on external pages linked from the README.
motivation: The README states the plugin is aimed at users in China, providing encrypted sync through mainstream commercial cloud storage platforms.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync notes across devices with client-side encryption through third-party cloud storage, especially for users in China.

relations.evidence: 已通过 BRAT 安装的用户，可继续使用仓库 adventurer2008/obsidian-smart-sync-release-cn 更新

requires.name: Paid yearly storage plans beyond 100 MB free tier

summary: Sync service plugin that encrypts notes and attachments on-device with AES-256-GCM before uploading to commercial cloud storage, with free and paid tiers.
